title: SDK imageEdit() with multiple images sends an illegal body and gets a 400 — the documented example is broken
author: NamanSoni78

gist.summary: Fixed the JavaScript SDK’s imageEdit() request for multiple source images: arrays of URL strings are now sent as { image_url } objects, matching the /v1/images/edits JSON schema instead of returning a 400. Single-image strings remain unchanged, and a test covers the multi-image request body.
